app.name: CRM-DAM
app.description: Image library and licensing for a design agency and its clients.

login.title: Log in
login.incorrect: Incorrect email or password. Contact the agency to set up a new password.
login.inactive: Your account is not active. Contact the agency.

search.staff: Search title, description, keywords and places

library.title: Library
library.filtersEmpty: Filters appear when the library has images.
library.empty: The library has no images yet.

upload.title: Upload
upload.start: Start a new batch, then add the JPEG or PNG files you want in the library.
upload.dropZone: Drop JPEG or PNG files here, up to 50 MB each
upload.dropAnywhere: or drop JPEG or PNG files anywhere on this page, up to 50 MB each
upload.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the last file has uploaded.

rejected.notImage: {name} was not uploaded: it is not a JPEG or PNG image.
rejected.tooLarge: {name} was not uploaded: it is larger than 50 MB.
rejected.damaged: {name} was not uploaded: the file is damaged.
rejected.unsafePreview: {name} was not uploaded: its preview could not be made safely. Try again.
rejected.connectionLost: {name} was not uploaded: the connection was lost. Add the file again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.empty: The agency has not shared any images with you yet.

findImages.title: Find images
findImages.empty: There are no images to show yet.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: You do not have access to this page. Go to your start page, or contact the agency if you think you should have access.

accounts.emailTaken: This email address is already in use. Use another one, or find the existing user.

errors.notFound: We could not find what you asked for. Check the address, or go back and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this. Contact the agency if you think you should.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this at the same time. Reload the page and try again.
errors.validation: Some of the information is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.locked: Someone else is editing this right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again, and contact the agency if it keeps happening.
